trace.answer_for_eval:
The steps to request a Transcript of Records are as follows:

1. Fill out and endorse request slip:
   - Agency action: Issues request slip (LSPU-REG-SF-011); reviews and checks the accomplished request against the student's clearance; assesses the corresponding fees of the requested documents.
   - Client action: Undergraduate students fill out the request slip with clearance and secure signatures of heads of responsible offices; graduates fill out the same request slip.
   - Processing time: 5 minutes
   - Next step: Pay required fees

2. Pay required fees:
   - Agency action: Receives payment and issues official receipt.
   - Client action: Proceeds to the Cashier's Office to pay the required fees.
   - Fees: P75.00/page (undergraduate), P150.00/page (graduate), among others
   - Processing time: 2 minutes
   - Next step: Submit receipt and request slip; receive claim stub; document preparation

3. Submit receipt and request slip; receive claim stub; document preparation:
   - Agency action: Receives and reviews the presented receipt and request slip; schedules the date of release; issues claim stub; locates the permanent record of the student concerned; prepares and encodes the requested document; reviews and counterchecks entries on the prepared draft; prints the final document; affixes the college seal; signs the document.
   - Client action: Submits the filled-out request slip and official receipt of payment and gets the claim stub with date of release.
   - Processing time: Up to 59 minutes total (including locating record, preparing/encoding, reviewing, printing, sealing, signing)
   - Next step: Claim requested document

4. Claim requested document:
   - Agency action: Records and releases the document.
   - Client action: Claims the requested document on the scheduled date indicated on the claim stub.
   - Processing time: 2 minutes

answer:
The steps to request a Transcript of Records are as follows:

1. Fill out and endorse request slip:
   - Agency action: Issues request slip (LSPU-REG-SF-011); reviews and checks the accomplished request against the student's clearance; assesses the corresponding fees of the requested documents.
   - Client action: Undergraduate students fill out the request slip with clearance and secure signatures of heads of responsible offices; graduates fill out the same request slip.
   - Processing time: 5 minutes
   - Next step: Pay required fees

2. Pay required fees:
   - Agency action: Receives payment and issues official receipt.
   - Client action: Proceeds to the Cashier's Office to pay the required fees.
   - Fees: P75.00/page (undergraduate), P150.00/page (graduate), among others
   - Processing time: 2 minutes
   - Next step: Submit receipt and request slip; receive claim stub; document preparation

3. Submit receipt and request slip; receive claim stub; document preparation:
   - Agency action: Receives and reviews the presented receipt and request slip; schedules the date of release; issues claim stub; locates the permanent record of the student concerned; prepares and encodes the requested document; reviews and counterchecks entries on the prepared draft; prints the final document; affixes the college seal; signs the document.
   - Client action: Submits the filled-out request slip and official receipt of payment and gets the claim stub with date of release.
   - Processing time: Up to 59 minutes total (including locating record, preparing/encoding, reviewing, printing, sealing, signing)
   - Next step: Claim requested document

4. Claim requested document:
   - Agency action: Records and releases the document.
   - Client action: Claims the requested document on the scheduled date indicated on the claim stub.
   - Processing time: 2 minutes
